title: SC01-T2 — the toast (SH04)
line: …thirty years. And I look at you lately and I just, I don't know. / You look like my mother, Susan. When did that happen?
motionPlan: Greg's voice above her goes quiet; her almost-smile goes; her eyes stay level, not on him; her right hand finds the edge of the table
note: Waits for its ingredients' Confirm (the voice masters and the cake card), then one Seedance call (§24K part 5).
